decisions.reason: The charting bundle is actively developed, with four releases in four weeks, and extends the core map.apps platform at low maintenance cost.
This niche bundle only gets a brief mention, but as a plugin within the map.apps ecosystem it costs little to keep available to customers.
The VueTOC mobile layer control was showcased on the home page as a new approach, and such components tend to be folded into the platform rather than formally withdrawn.
The GIS platform is the foundation of the firm's established business and the base on which its other bundles are sold.
Mobile field data capture is a strong use case for public-sector GIS customers and has its own product page, which signals commitment.
The search extension has its own page and complements the core web map apps, so it supports platform sales.
